description: This Harvard Dataverse deposit contains measured performance data for a nearly zero-energy office building known as Clinic Saint-Pierre near Brussels, Belgium. Researchers monitored building operation from May 2018 through April 2019 using an energy-management system and an outdoor weather station. Three unrestricted Excel workbooks provide hourly indoor and outdoor air temperatures, monthly heating and cooling energy use, and monthly greenhouse-gas estimates. The repository API identifies CC0 1.0; its HTML landing returned HTTP 202 in this environment. The article identifies the site as a commercial building with Passive House certification. Coverage is one building and one annual cycle, not a representative office stock or a utility network. Emissions are analysed outputs, not direct stack measurements, and monthly energy values cannot establish hourly demand peaks. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating temperature or thermal-energy components in building simulations. model-energyplus is a related building model, but no input conversion or independent calibration was performed. No workbook was downloaded or recalculated.
